verdicts.reason: A separates the cream circle from the bottle and leaves it as a meaningless half-cropped blob in the bottom-left corner, under a stray top-left circle. The bottle sits in a crowded middle and the headline floats at mid-left with no shared edge, so the brand motif is broken. B keeps the bottle-in-circle motif and a clear left-to-right row (product, NEW, Try It), but the headline is off-centre and lines up with nothing. NEW and Try It float far apart with uneven gutters, and there is wasted space on the right.
